title: Symrise breaks ground on the second phase of construction for its logistics center in Holzminden
summary: – Investment of approximately 25 million euros in the second phase of the project – Expansion of capacity and efficiency to strengthen global delivery capabilities – A symbol of growth, investment in the company headquarters, and a commitment to operational excellence
